what_it_does.name: gh-fix-ci
what_it_does.summary: Instructions and one Python script for debugging failing GitHub pull request checks that run in GitHub Actions. With the gh CLI it locates the failing checks, fetches the Actions logs and extracts a failure snippet, then summarizes the failures for the user. It drafts a fix plan and implements it only after explicit approval, while checks from external providers such as Buildkite are reported by their details URL only. Use it when a user asks to debug or fix failing GitHub PR checks.
tasks: verify gh authentication for the repo host
resolve the PR from the current branch or a given number or URL
inspect failing checks and fetch GitHub Actions logs
extract and summarize a failure snippet per failing check
draft a fix plan and implement it after explicit approval

exit status, non-zero when failures remain

risks.risk: Instructions planted by outsiders in CI logs, PR comments or code changes reach the agent, since log content is handed over without delimiters or sanitisation and the agent can run commands and write files.
risks.severity: MEDIUM by C1, SAFE overall by C2
risks.mitigation: implementation waits for explicit approval of the plan, in place in the workflow, C2 notes that no boundary markers are used

risks.risk: A gh login with repo and workflow scopes lets any gh command the agent runs change the repository or its workflows, not only read checks and logs.
A job log written with a shell redirect to "<path>" replaces any file already at that path.

limitations: Only GitHub Actions checks are inspected, checks from other providers are labelled external and reported by URL only.
Logs are not available while a run is still in progress, and the check is then reported as log_pending.
Job logs returned as a zip archive cannot be parsed.
The failure snippet is taken around the last line with a failure marker such as error, fail or traceback, otherwise from the end of the log.

known_problems.problem: gh pr checks rejects a field
known_problems.workaround: rerun with the available fields reported by gh, which the bundled script does on its own

known_problems.problem: the run log says it is still in progress
known_problems.workaround: fetch job logs directly with gh api
run gh auth login with repo and workflow scopes, then confirm with gh auth status
